subject: general
question: Express sin 58° + cos 82° in terms of Trigonometric ratios of angles between 0° and 45°.
solution:
**Given:**

sin 58º + cos 82º

**Formula used:**

cos(90 - xº) = sin xº

sin(90 - xº) = cos x°

**Calculation:**

⇒ sin 58° + cos 82°

⇒ sin (90 - 58°) + cos (90 - 82°)

As all comes in first quadrant so 

sin will change to cos

And cos will change to sin and all will remain positive

⇒ cos 32° + sin 8°

**⇒ Hence, Option 1 is correct**
